Each line should contain no more than 50 characters, including spaces' (title_chars 150 is that, three lines of 50). Its article-types page gives the 7,000 words and 7 display items. Text in Word, 12-point Times New Roman, 1.5 line spacing, continuous line numbers. (2026-11-16 earlier: the same from the Internet Archive's copy of 2025-05-28.)
